Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL—Planned maintenance notifications now in preview

Body.Content:
The planned maintenance notifications feature of Azure Database for PostgreSQL—Single Server is now in preview. Use this feature to receive alerts about upcoming planned maintenance to your Azure Database for PostgreSQL. View all planned maintenance for the services in your subscription in one place, and set up service health alerts to notify you up to 72 hours in advance when there are issues or changes that may affect the Azure services and regions you use.

Read more about creating activity log alerts for planned maintenance notifications in the service documentation.

Try this feature and provide feedback in the forum or directly to the Azure Database for PostgreSQL team.
